description: This file contains the implementation of the CategoryService interface, providing business logic for managing categories within a sales and catalog management system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting categories, handling parent-child relationships, and querying categories based on various criteria.

classes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CategoryService interface that handles category-related business logic, including creating, updating, listing, deleting, and managing category relationships within a store context.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new category, sets its lineage and depth based on its parent, and saves it to the database.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Returns a count of products grouped by categories within a store context.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching specified codes within a store.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching specified IDs within a store.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new category or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories based on a lineage string within a store context.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Lists categories matching a SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a category matching a SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by code within a store.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists child categories of a given category.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories for a given store and parent category.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories by depth level within a store.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a category in a specific language.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child category to a parent, updating lineage and depth accordingly.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category and its related products and subcategories, handling product-category relationships.

methods.name: addCategoryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a category.
